name: CN_RS_RULE_ASSIGNMENTS_ALL
description: This table has the link information between the Rules and the Eligible Categories for Classification Rules or the Sales Person Assignments for the Crediting Rules.

columns.name: RULE_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to cn_rs_rules_all_b.rule_id

columns.name: ASSIGNED_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for salesreps/group/team/eligible category

columns.name: ASSIGNED_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether the assignment is a resource or group or team or eligible category

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ROLE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of role

columns.name: START_DATE

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End Date of the rule and party association

columns.name: SPLIT_PCT
columns.description: Split Percentage

columns.name: REVENUE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicated whether it is REVENUE or NON-REVENUE

columns.name: ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether rollup will be done for the credit receiver

columns.name: GROUP_MEMBER_CREDIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicated in rollup hierarchy whether a member of the group  will get credit for other group member direct credits.

columns.name: SUMMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether participant will receive summarized direct credit or individual direct credit as indirect credits

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.
